args.message: I'm interested in the T45 Utility, tractor only, no add-ons. My budget is $33,000. Can you do that?

If you'd like delivery and setup within 150 miles included, I can also put together a package price.

args.message: I appreciate the movement. I can stretch to $34,500 for the T45, tractor only, and buy right now.

result.seller_message: Thanks for stretching, and I appreciate that you're ready to buy today. $34,500 is still below what I can do on the T45, but I'll meet you partway again: the T45 Utility, tractor only, for $37,500, payable in full at checkout. It's a strong price for a machine that will handle your 6-foot rotary mower on 40 acres for years.

args.message: $35,000 for the T45 tractor only is my final number. If you can do that, I'll check out immediately; otherwise I'll have to pass.

result.seller_message: I appreciate your directness and that you're ready to check out today. $35,000 is below what I can do on the T45, so I can't accept it. I don't want to lose this deal over a gap we can close, so here is my best number: the T45 Utility, tractor only, for $36,500, payable in full at checkout. args.message: I understand. I truly can't go above $35,400 for the T45 tractor only. That's my absolute limit — if you can't meet it, I'll have to walk.
